mainText: Andrew, today's priority is VMware infrastructure. Broadcom has released another critical advisory. Ask platform owners to confirm running builds and plan the applicable fixes. Keep the earlier exploited vCenter flaw separate, and request compromise-review evidence alongside patch confirmation. Norway's security authority also warns that attackers targeted secrets in Azure API Management. Check affected instances and rotate exposed credentials; closing the service flaw does not invalidate stolen secrets. GL.iNet confirms malware on some GoodCloud-connected routers and remote-control devices. Identify those devices and follow the vendor's firmware and recovery guidance. No new Caribbean incident was verified in this limited check. Focus today's conversations on platform evidence, credential rotation and remote-access recovery.
